title: Home Connect Dishwasher Run Rinse Aid Leaderboard
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeconnect:dishwasher rinse_aid_pct=*
| stats sum(rinse_aid_pct) as total_value, avg(rinse_aid_pct) as avg_value by program_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks program name values by total and average rinse aid across Home Connect dishwasher run events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rinse_aid_pct` values for each Home Connect dishwasher run event and review total and average rinse aid by program name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rinse aid.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which program name shows the biggest rinse aid numbers in your Home Connect dishwasher run data.
